svg.title: Exponential backoff
svg.desc: Six game clients lose the matchmaking server at the same moment and retry with waits of 1, 2 and 4 seconds. Without jitter all six retry at the same instants, and each wave overloads the server again. With jitter each client picks a random wait, the retries spread out and every client connects.
svg.text: No jitter: retries land in waves. Jitter spreads them into a trickle.
